consent.title: Samsung Health Wearables Study
consent.intro: You are about to start the process of donating your Samsung Health data to our study. The data that we ask you to donate will be used for academic research to gain insight into physical activity, sleep, and wellbeing behaviors. Only daily summaries are extracted: movement (steps, distance, active time, energy, floors), heart rate, stress, blood oxygen and respiration per day, nightly sleep, and your recorded exercises. Your account name, profile (birth date, height, weight), device identifiers, exercise titles and comments, GPS routes and locations, food, water, and cycle-tracking data are never read or transmitted.
consent.process: We will walk you through this process step by step. During this process no data is stored or sent to a server. You can filter by date, exclude exercise types, and delete rows from the data before donating. Data will only be donated and stored when you click the button "Yes, donate" on the page that shows your data.
agreementPoints: you fully and voluntarily agree to donate your data for this research.
you are aware that when your data is used for academic publications, or made publicly available in some other form, this will be anonymous.
you are aware that you have the right to withdraw your permission.
consent.agreementCheckbox: I have read and agree with the above terms.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.intro: Please download your Samsung Health data: open the Samsung Health app, tap the menu (three lines or dots) → Settings → "Download personal data" → Download, and confirm with your Samsung account. The app saves a folder on your phone. Then open the My Files app → Internal storage → Download → Samsung Health, press and hold the folder that starts with "samsunghealth_", and choose "Compress" (or "Zip") to create a .zip file. Upload that .zip file here.
upload.processing: Processing your file... This may take a few moments for large exports.
upload.incorrectFile: The uploaded file might be incorrect, corrupted, or void of Samsung Health data.
upload.possibleIssues: We were unable to find any recognizable Samsung Health data in the uploaded file. This could mean:
issuePoints: The file is not a zipped Samsung Health "Download personal data" folder
Only part of the folder was compressed (the .csv files must be included)
The file is corrupted or incomplete
Your Samsung Health account has no activity, sleep, or exercise data
upload.checkFile: Please check that you have uploaded a .zip of the whole samsunghealth_… folder or contact the researchers for assistance.
upload.note: Note: The process to extract the correct data from the file is done on your own computer. No data is stored or sent yet. Extraction may take a while for large exports.

filter.intro: Determine whether you would like to donate the data below. Carefully check the data and adjust when required. You can filter by date range and exclude specific exercise types. With your donation you contribute to the previously described research. Thank you in advance.
filter.donationPrompt: Do you want to donate the above data?
filter.note: Note: Sending the data may take several seconds depending on the data size.

thankyou.title: Thank You!
thankyou.successMessage: Your data has been successfully submitted. Thank you for your contribution!
thankyou.saveId: Please save this ID for your records.
thankyou.declineMessage: Thank you for your time. Your decision has been recorded and no data has been shared.
